tax_rule_candidates.base_note: RESOLVED 2026-09-02 from primary text. PP 34/2017 Pasal 4(2), read from archived bytes (DJP_PPH42_PP34_004): jumlah bruto is all amounts paid or owed by the Penyewa relating to the rented property INCLUDING biaya perawatan, pemeliharaan, keamanan, layanan dan fasilitas lainnya, 'baik yang perjanjiannya dibuat secara terpisah maupun yang disatukan'.
tax_rule_candidates.who_withholds: PP 34/2017 Pasal 3(1)-(2): the Penyewa withholds where it acts as or is appointed Pemotong; Pemotong includes badan pemerintah and subjek pajak badan dalam negeri.
tax_rule_candidates.notes: Rate 10% final and the gross definition now cited to PRIMARY regulation text (PP 34/2017). BLOCKER CLOSED. Remains under_review: currency of PP 34/2017 unconfirmed, the full Pemotong list was not read, and the mixed-invoice boundary is unresolved — see TXN_MIXED_INVOICE.

related_risk.detail: DJP_PPH42_006 (fetch-verified) states that building services from a THIRD-PARTY provider are 'jasa manajemen' taxed at 2% under Pasal 23. A rental invoice bundling rent and a service charge may therefore carry TWO different taxes. The engine must not apply one rate to the whole invoice.
